QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_60

explanation.text: The Logic: MDD = (Trough − Peak) / Peak, usually expressed as a negative percentage. The Trap: Alternate arrangements are incorrect; volatility formula is not MDD. Cross-Exam Context: Cross-exam with XV, X-A. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Larger negative MDD = worse downside; always examine WHEN the drawdown occurred.
